Koramangala, Bengaluru, India
Experienced frontend developer focused on Vue.js single-page applications, component-driven UI and design system implementation. Notice period: 60 days.

Senior Vue.js Developer, Tata Consultancy Services — Jan 2019 - Present
Led development of a customer-facing enterprise portal built with Vue.js, implementing reusable component libraries and responsive layouts. Implemented Tailwind CSS utility classes across the app to reduce stylesheet size and accelerate feature delivery. Improved page load performance by 28% through CSS optimization and code-splitting of JavaScript bundles. Collaborated in Agile sprints to deliver bi-weekly releases and authored unit-tested Vue.js components used across three product modules.

Vue.js Developer, Capgemini — Oct 2018 - Dec 2018
Contributed to a marketing dashboard using Vue.js and modular CSS, building interactive widgets and accessible form components. Implemented responsive templates with CSS and semantic HTML, enabling the team to cut frontend defects by 20% during release testing. Participated in sprint planning and peer code reviews to maintain consistent Vue.js patterns.

Vue.js Developer, Infosys — Apr 2018 - Sep 2018
Built interactive UI features using JavaScript and integrated Tailwind CSS utilities to standardize spacing and typography across pages. Worked with backend APIs to render dynamic content and optimized client-side JS to reduce CPU usage on low-end devices. Engaged in Agile ceremonies to continuously refine requirements and deliver incremental UI improvements.

Skills: Vue.js, JS, CSS, HTML, Tailwind CSS, Agile

Education: B.Des, NID Ahmedabad
